findings.title: Synonym collapse: "sheetrock" returns ~1% of the drywall assortment
findings.detail: "sheetrock" and "sheet rock" redirect to a narrow USG-brand category with 33 products, while "drywall" returns 2411 and "drywall sheets" returns 921. A shopper using the everyday word "sheetrock" is shown 33 of ~2400 drywall products.

findings.title: Dimension unit conflation: "1/2 ft" returns 1/2-inch products
findings.detail: "1/2 ft" (half a foot) and "1/2 ft screw" return 1/2-INCH items (plywood, PVC conduit, 1/2 in screws). The fraction 1/2 is matched but the unit "ft" is dropped, so half-foot intent yields half-inch results.

findings.title: Format-based count inconsistency for the same lumber query
findings.detail: "2x4", "2 by 4", and "2 x 4" all return correct 2x4 lumber up top but with 757 / 1043 / 4586 results respectively — a 6x swing in result-set size driven purely by spacing/format normalization.

passes: Pro/trade names map correctly: romex -> Romex NM-B wire (1797), unistrut -> strut channel (1759).
Spelled fractions handled: "half inch drywall" -> 1/2 in drywall panels (953).
Dimension queries with product context are relevant: "1/2 in screw", "#2 phillips bit", "3/4 plywood".
Concept queries redirect to the right category: "cordless drill" -> Cordless Drills, "hammer" -> Hammers.
